services.name: Dolphin Tour
services.desc: About Feet Wet Adventures offers a fantastic opportunity to witness these intelligent marine mammals in their natural habitat. During the tour, you'll have the chance to see dolphins swimming, playing, and feeding in their natural environment. Dolphins are often curious creatures, and they may even approach the boat to get a closer look at the passengers. The guides will share interesting facts about dolphins, their behavior, and the surrounding ecosystem, providing an educational experience for participants of all ages. In addition to dolphins, you might also encounter other marine life such as manatees, sea turtles, various bird species, and even occasional sightings of sharks or rays,
